[[Doctor]] '''Rispi Lacendad''' was a family physician. [[Gender/Legends|He]] ran a clinic in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo District]], with individuals of the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] species making up almost half of his clientele. After a study by [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|Rhire Medical Academy]] found Chadra-Fan&mdash;among other species&mdash;to be at risk of disease from air pollution, Rhine commented to [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] on the matter, noting that he encouraged his Chadra-Fan patients to don [[Breath mask/Legends|breathmasks]] when outdoors.<ref name="HNN 49" />
